cast.characterName: ミハイル・ロア・バルダムヨォン
cast.originalCharacterName: ミハイル・ロア・バルダムヨォン

segments.text: A numberless Dead Apostle that Arcueid is searching for. He was a priest who sought immortality and was able to obtain it through reincarnation.
He tricked Arcueid into drinking his blood, therefore making him a vampire.

He is an antagonist in most routes of the game. Roa was taught a Reality Marble known as "The Soil of Genesis" which can only be destroyed with something that has a destructive power of something that can destroy a continent. It functions as some kind of cage or restraining device.

His original body was finally defeated by a coalition composed of Arcueid and the Church's Burial Agency, and he has been re-incarnating ever since then. By the time of Tsukihime he had already re-incarnated seventeen times and had been destroyed by Arcueid each time as she seeks to gain her stolen power back, and perhaps to achieve some measure of revenge. Roa has two requirements for choosing the host of his next reincarnation: the host's family must have a high social standing so that he would be born into luxury, and a body with high magical potential and perhaps unique latent powers.

His last host was Ciel, who was chosen in haste and thus was born into a bakery's family but in exchange had a body with an extremely high magical potential that was relatively close to that of his original form.
In Tsukihime, Roa is responsible for the grisly vampire murders throughout the city.
From Wikipedia.

cast.characterName: リーズバイフェ・ストリンドヴァリ
cast.originalCharacterName: リーズバイフェ・ストリンドヴァリ

segments.text: Riesbyfe was a vampire hunter from the Church and a leader of the knight's heresy persecution group. She is also a friend of Sion Eltnam Atlasia and died rescuing her from Wallachia three years before the events of Melty Blood. Even after resurrecting as another materialization of TATARI, she's still hasn't been absorbed by it, thanks to her Holy Shield, Gamaliel.

Being the same form of existence as Neco-Arc, he's mostly talking nonsense and breaking the fourth wall. When not psycho, he acts polite and smokes a cigarette. Neco-Arc Chaos is obviously a parody of Nrvnqsr Chaos, and he has similar ability to create the animals from his own body.

Neco-Arc is a member of the NEKO Spirit race, originating from the Great Cat's Village. It's either a materialization of TATARI or the guest from another world brought here by Zelretch, as well as the mascot character of Type-Moon.
She speaks with the catlike accent and likes to play on the nerves of others. Even her appearance frightens certain characters.
Present in Tsukihime Remake, but only in After Bad End scenes.

cast.characterName: 真祖 アルクェイド
cast.originalCharacterName: 真祖 アルクェイド

segments.text: The awakened, true form of Arcueid Brunestud. She represents the Earth’s consciousness and will, transcending her identity as a True Ancestor to become “Type Earth”—the planet’s ultimate defense mechanism and avatar. Arche-Type Earth embodies the full potential of the world’s energy, standing as one of the most powerful beings in the Nasuverse, equivalent to other celestial entities that protect their respective planets.

In this form, Arcueid’s appearance and abilities change dramatically. As Arche-Type Earth, she has access to nearly limitless regenerative powers, reality manipulation, and immunity to mortal limitations, embodying the Earth’s immense willpower. This transformation is rare and appears only when the planet itself is in grave danger, making her a near-unstoppable force.

Dust of Osiris is a potential future version of Sion Eltnam Atlasia created by Wallachia from remnants of her soul. She is known as the 13th of the 27 Ancestors of Dead Apostles. She has no ego nor emotions and behaves more like computer, always busy with calculations and recalculations. Dust of Osiris tries to recreate the "Hologram Summer" from the previous year, destroy the future and keep an eternal record, as she believes there is no future for the mankind anyway.

Kouma is a result of mixing bloods in many generations, someone who shouldn't have been born. He was like an abandoned child, whom no one wanted to take care of. So close to people, yet so far from them. Just like Mowgli, he would have rather been among the animals, than the humans.
Kouma was the one who killed Nanaya clan, but spared Shiki's life for some reason.

White Len is a familiar created by Aozaki Aoko from the remains of Wallachia and borrowed Len's appearance as well as her suppressed personality. Therefore, unlike Len, she's talkative, arrogant and immature at times. Yet, she's honest to herself. White Len has same kind of powers, which are enhanced by TATARI.
She formed a contract with Nanaya Shiki.

Nanaya Shiki is an alternate version of Tohno Shiki created from his subconscious. Being a natural born killer, he seems calm and composed, but having evil tongue, he's prone to making sarcastic comments. Still, unlike Tohno, Nanaya is obsessed with killing.
One day a fate will bind him with White Len through the strange kind of relationships.
Mech-Hisui is a heavily armed robot created by Kohaku in the image and likeness of Hisui. It has become possible only after TATARI's intervention, though.
Mech-Hisui is emotionless most of the time, but in the end it didn't stop her from rebelling against Dr. Kohaku and gain some Skynet-like ambitions.

cast.characterName: 暴走 アルクェイド
cast.originalCharacterName: 暴走 アルクェイド

segments.text: Red Arcueid is an illusion created by Wallachia from Arcueid's fear of surrendering to her bloodlust, going insane and killing people just for fun. So, that's exactly what Red Arc likes to do.
This Sion was completely turned into vampire. She became TATARI's successor. She has inherited all of the countless victims absorbed by Wallachia over the years and kept them as information.

Night of Wallachia is the 13th of The 27 Dead Apostle Ancestors. He doesn't actually exist, and his nature is that of a phenomenon known as TATARI, a recurring event that grants physical shape to the fears and rumors that circulate within a community.
His name before becoming TATARI was Zepia Eltnam Oberon. He was a genius alchemist from Atlas and the ancestor of Sion Eltnam Atlasia.
Toono Shiki's step sister, who became close to him while he was living in the Arima family.

Ryougi Shiki was born in the family of demon hunters. She's a girl who possesses the Mystic Eyes of Death Perception (similar to Toono Shiki's), a supernatural ability that allows her to see the "lines of death" on any living or non-living object.
Ryougi assists the "Garan no Dou" agency run by Aozaki Touko, helping to handle the paranormal cases when combat is required.

The spirit of Ciel's weapon, the Seventh Holy Scripture; referred to as "Seven" by Ciel, but nicknamed "Nanako" by Arihiko. She has hoofed feet and a horse tail. She also has the ability to transform into a winged horse, and is quite scared of her master, Ciel.
She is a combination of the spirit of a girl from a poor family who willingly offered her life as a sacrifice to be combined with the spirit of a unicorn's horn.
From Wikipedia.

Hanei Misawa is one of Akiha Tohno's roommates at her school, Asagami Private Girls Academy, along with Tsukihime Souka. Nicknamed 'Hanepin', she is slow-witted, conscientious, thorough and good at fixing things.
From TYPE-MOON Wiki.
Souka Tsukihime is one of Tohno Akiha's roommates at her school, Asagami Private Girls Academy, along with Misawa Hanei.
From TYPE-MOON Wiki.
Shiki is a kind, honest, if not slightly playful second-year high school student. He is anemic and is prone to fainting, but he tries his best to live a normal life.

He has the Mystic Eyes of Death Perception, allowing him to see the "Lines" and "Points" that enable him to kill all things using the highly effective assassination techniques hidden in his subconscious. Despite being constantly surrounded by death he has a greater appreciation for life than most people and would never take a human life.
From Wikipedia

cast.characterName: アルクェイド・ブリュンスタッド
cast.originalCharacterName: アルクェイド・ブリュンスタッド

segments.text: Arcueid is a vampire hunting others of her kind. She "convinces" Shiki to help her deal with the vampire in the town as she used up most of her power because of him.

Arcueid is shown to be a whimsical individual who, although knowing the basics of the modern era, does not seem to know about social norms. Her behaviour is almost child-like, due to the lonely nature of her up bringing, although she is over 800 years old, she spent most of it asleep and knows nearly nothing about the world or how to interact with others.
Second paragraph edited from Typemoon Wikia
Ciel is a senior attending the same school as Shiki, where she is the president and only member of the tea ceremony club, and also good friends with Inui, Satsuki and Shiki himself.
Her outward demeanor is that of a calm, friendly, and peaceful person.
Edited from Wikipedia

Born into the prestigious Toono family, Akiha lived a sheltered childhood. Thanks to her brother Shiki she was able to experience at least some semblance of the joys of childhood. Unfortunately not soon afterwards, Shiki was near-fatally wounded in an accident and was sent by Makihisa to live with the Arimas, relatives from another branch of the family. Contact was made impossible when Akiha was placed in a boarding school and she was forced to live on campus.

Upon the death of their father eight years later, Akiha became the head of the Toono household and, ignoring protests from the remaining relatives, called Shiki back to live at the family mansion with her.

Akiha is very protective of her brother. She is always intent on knowing what he does with his day, and is extremely suspicious of what he does at night. She gets incredibly jealous when he is around other girls.
Edited from Typemoon Wikia
The older of the two twin maids in the Toono mansion,
Kohaku, along with her sister Hisui, is a childhood friend of Shiki.
She wears a Japanese kimono and is always seen to be smiling and cheerful, being especially gifted with medicine.
From Wikipedia

Hisui plays the role of cleaning maid to the Toono family. Always wearing her western maid uniform, Hisui can always be found tidying up the lobby, dusting the rooms of the mansion or waiting for Shiki to return at the gates.
From Wikipedia

cast.originalCharacterName: シオン・エルトナム・アトラシア

segments.text: Sion is an alchemist of Atlas, one of the three main branches of the Mages Association. She is a genius scientist, given a position equal to the representative of ATLAS at an extremely young age. Although she is usually calm and calculating, always striving for perfection, she is actually quite emotional and extremely easy to set off.
From Wikipedia
Akiha's friend from her boarding school. Her eyes give her a limited ability to see the future, although usually not entirely clearly.
From Wikipedia

Len is a cat familiar that can influence dreams like her creator. She is a hybrid of a cat's body and a human's spirit. She has no recollection of her previous life since she is not resurrected but rather a new life created by magic.
Len is a silent girl who rarely speaks. Her demeanour is quiet and unimposing. But she can be grumpy at times, though she hides it well. Her human shape is an illusion since her real body is a cat.
From Wikipedia
Shiki's classmate and friend, who likes him very much.
She is shy and has somewhat of an inferiority complex. She has a crush on Shiki, although he is completely oblivious of this and regards her as just another classmate.
Edited from Wikipedia

This vampire is known as the tenth of the twenty-seven Ancestors of Dead Apostles, as well as the highest ranking vampire to appear in Tsukihime. Has 666 beasts on his body, from deer and wolves to mythological creatures like unicorns.
The only conventional way to kill him is to destroy all 666 beasts at once or he will constantly regenerate; to kill him is practically impossible.
